reached_sql:
WITH dw1 AS (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM
        store_sales
    JOIN
        date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN
        store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    JOIN
        item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    WHERE
        date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
    GROUP BY
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id
)
SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
FROM
    dw1
WHERE
    rk <= 100
ORDER BY
    i_category,
    i_class,
    i_brand,
    i_product_name,
    d_year,
    d_qoy,
    d_moy,
    s_store_id
LIMIT 100
